title: Add bidirectional source support, field provenance, and resolved ownership
description:
Implement source-to-output AND output-to-source validation at clause and field
level.

Root cause: coverage gates are source->output only. Nothing proves that an
emitted value is supported by the source it cites, so fabricated or
editorially-repaired content passes through a plausible locator. That is exactly
how table:starting-wealth-by-class — hardcoded PHB content emitted by the
importer's emit.ts startingWealthTable() — acquired "SRD 5.1 p. 38" provenance
and the CC-BY-4.0 SRD attribution block despite no starting-wealth text existing
anywhere in SRD 5.1.

Every output value must be exactly one of: directly sourced from a pinned source
span; deterministically derived from pinned source spans with derivation
metadata; supplemental content with a distinct source/license identity; or an
explicit unresolved source defect / campaign ruling. No hand-authored value may
inherit the SRD license/provenance block by default.

Closes findings: SOL-008, SOL-009, CAP-009, CAP-010, F-19, Fable F1, Fable F4,
Fable F5, Fable F7.
design:
Pack evidence on main @4384f25:
- table:starting-wealth-by-class carries source "SRD 5.1 p. 38" + full CC-BY SRD
  attribution; content is not in SRD 5.1. Consumed by srdStartingWealth.ts and
  finalizeCharacter.ts, so removal is a coordinated change (see B1).
- 7 container records cite p. 69 while capacity prints on p. 70.
- table:scrying carries invented "Basis"/"Circumstance" headers.
- acolyte choices[].sourceText labels are synthesized, not verbatim.

Coordinate span identity with A1 clause identity.
acceptance_criteria:
- Supplemental (non-SRD) content carries a source and license identity separate from SRD-sourced content, and a compiler-authored value cannot acquire the SRD license/provenance block by default (negative regression).
- Remaining scope is ONLY the above; the rest of the original contract is re-owned as recorded in notes.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
